text:
ryan: Heads-up — opening a tiny docs PR to patch a few Dedicated provisioning gaps. Will tag owners shortly.
ryan: Scope: short autoscale policy examples, one-line SLA clarification for preemption, a compact SDK snippet showing tenant-scoped reservation, and a couple link fixes.
maria: Thanks — can you call out where the SLA wording diverges from the legal text? That's caused confusion before.
ryan: Yeah — current text says 'best-effort preemption handling' which is too vague. Proposal: replace with 'SLA excludes preemption events originating from customer-managed infra; Redwood will provide best-effort mitigation and audit logs.' Short, actionable.
ben: SGTM. Also please add a tiny table mapping policy names to expected behavior (eg: burstable, steady, spot-fallback). Docs readers often ask which one to pick.
alice: For autoscale examples can we add two short YAML snippets: one for latency-sensitive (min 2, max 20, burst 40) and one for cost-sensitive (min 1, max 5, spot-fallback)? Keep them <=6 lines each.
katie: If you paste code, I'll run it through the docs linter + link checker. We had dead links in that section last month.
ryan: Pushing draft now: PR includes 
```yaml
# latency-sensitive
policy:
  min_replicas: 2
  max_replicas: 20
  burst_capacity: 40
  target_p99_latency_ms: 120
```
and
```yaml
# cost-sensitive
policy:
  min_replicas: 1
  max_replicas: 5
  fallback: spot
  target_p90_latency_ms: 250
```
ryan: SDK snippet (python) — tenant reservation + quick check:
```python
from redwood import DedicatedClient
cli = DedicatedClient(api_key=KEY)
res = cli.reserve_capacity(tenant_id="acct-123", pool="gpu-A100", replicas=4)
print(res.status)
```
maria: Nice. Add a short note: "Example assumes tenant has permissions to reserve in the target pool."
ben: Also please add a one-sentence migration tip: "When migrating tenants from shared to dedicated, do a 24-hour canary with mirrored traffic to validate caching/kv behaviour."
alice: Link fixes: change /guides/dedicated/provisioning#isolation to /guides/dedicated/provisioning#tenant-isolation and update the anchor used in the handbook. katie will run link checker.
katie: On it — I'll queue the linter. If it passes, we can merge small patch without a full docs review per our tiny-change guideline.
docs-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4821 — labels: docs, dedicated, quickpatch. CI: docs-lint queued.
ryan: Thanks all. If the linter flags anything minor (formatting or anchors) I'll push a follow-up. Otherwise I'll merge EOD.
maria: Could you also add a short changelog line summarizing the SLA wording change so support has a clear note?
ryan: Yep — adding a one-liner to CHANGES.md: "Clarify preemption exclusion in Dedicated SLA; add autoscale examples and SDK reservation snippet."
ben: Taking note for the handbook sync — I’ll update internal playbook if you merge.
katie: Linter green — small nit: replace a couple of smart quotes introduced by copy/paste; I fixed in the branch.
docs-bot: CI passed — docs-lint, link-checker.
ryan: Merged. Thanks everyone :rocket: 
ben: Great, can we also make a follow-up issue to add an example Terraform snippet? This PR is getting dense.
maria: Agreed; I'll open a short ticket and tag infra to contribute a sample TF module.
ryan: Filed: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/314 — Terraform sample requested. Closing thread after handoff.
katie: Thx — closing loop in handbook docs checklist.
